promise: Nvidia will manufacture up to $500 billion of AI chips and supercomputers in the U.S. over the next four years
description: Nvidia announced it will build AI supercomputers entirely on U.S. soil for the first time, producing up to $500 billion of domestic AI infrastructure over four years with partners such as TSMC, including Blackwell chip production in Arizona and new supercomputer manufacturing plants in Texas.
evidence: Reuters and AP coverage of the $500 billion four-year commitment
